templates.name: Thank-You After Interview
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

Thank you so much for taking the time to speak with me today about the [Role] position at [Company]. I really enjoyed learning more about the team's work on [topic discussed] and the direction you're heading.

Our conversation reinforced my excitement about this opportunity. I believe my experience with [relevant skills] would let me contribute quickly and meaningfully.

I look forward to hearing about the next steps. Please don't hesitate to reach out if you need anything else from my end.

Best regards,
Jordan

templates.name: Follow-Up After Application
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

I hope you're doing well. I wanted to follow up on my application for the [Role] position at [Company] submitted on [Date].

I remain very interested in this opportunity and would love the chance to discuss how my background in [skills] could be a strong fit for your team.

Please let me know if there's any additional information I can provide. I appreciate your time and consideration.

Best,
Jordan

templates.name: Offer Negotiation
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

Thank you so much for the offer — I'm genuinely excited about the opportunity to join [Company] and contribute to [Team/Project].

After careful consideration, I'd love to discuss the base salary. Based on my research into market rates for this role and my experience with [skills], I was hoping we could explore [target salary]. I'm flexible and open to discussing the full package including equity and benefits.

I'm very enthusiastic about this role and confident we can find something that works for both sides.

Thank you again for the offer and for your consideration.

Best,
Jordan
